{{more citations needed|date=November 2017}}
In [[category theory]], a '''tetracategory''' is a weakened definition of a [[4-category]]. The definition of tetracategory and its [[coherence condition]]s were introduced by Trimble.  The formal definition of Trimble's tetracategory is given using the coherence theorem for [[tricategory|tricategories]]. There is no coherence theorem for tetracategories yet.{{sfn|Crans|2000}} Hoffnung says that, a [[monoidal category|monoidal]] tricategory is a one-object tetracategory in the sense of Trimble.{{sfn|Hoffnung|2011}}
